policy: Selected numerical source data and interpretation, not article prose. Document hashes refer to downloaded primary papers.

sources.scope: A radius from interferometry; B radius from surface-brightness/color relation, not its noisier direct interferometric diameter. A temperature from flux/diameter; B temperature and luminosity depend on atmospheric/BC models. Masses and age are evolutionary estimates; age assumes coeval formation. Component V is a flux decomposition with an adopted 503-nm contrast. Uses original Hipparcos parallax 28.60 +/- 0.69 mas, not the current catalog distance.

sources.section: Table 3 and Table 5, solution SB1+p(parallax)+p(primary mass | spectral type)
sources.scope: MAP estimates and 95 percent highest-density posterior intervals, not Gaussian one-sigma errors. SB1 masses are conditional on both priors; secondary bounds use products of marginal bounds, not independent credible intervals. Dubhe mass solution is not adopted because of conflicting current primary mass; RV solution remains useful.

sources.section: Table 7, solution C4; sections V.4 and VI.1
sources.scope: Preferred C4 identification Aa=narrow-lined A2, Ab=broad-lined A1; alternatives exist. Temperatures are conservative adopted estimates, particularly the Be star temperature from classification. Inner luminosities and polar radii are rough rotating-star models with no formal errors. Polar radii are preserved here and are not adopted as spherical catalog radii. Model age is approximate and conditional. The catalog wide Ba/Bb pair is outside this three-star solution; no systemic velocity or physical measurements are copied to that pair.

sources.section: Tables 3 and 8, scaled RV error solutions
sources.scope: Scaled RV errors adopted. The paper discusses RV zero-point differences. Mizar A gamma is a subsystem proxy for the larger Mizar/Alcor system, not a measurement of the six-star barycenter.
Porrima total dynamical mass cannot be split into two measured individual masses. No new component mass is adopted from this source.
